correctness.rationale: The centered coefficient formula reduces to a finite trapezoidal sum of piecewise quadratic tent products; composite quadrature error is O_k(m^-2) after normalization. Exact tent integrals factor as P_k=(z²+4z+1)S_k². Rouché handles simple root displacement O(m^-2) and double root clusters O(m^-1); positivity/reciprocity gives one in/out per cluster; Deng–Fu positive root-of-unity lower bound yields Ω(m^-1) from product factorization. Independently checked reciprocal coefficients and scaled error k=4,5,6. Finite tests are not asymptotic proofs.
